Avenir Has Boosted Its Stake in Macquarie Infrastr Co (MIC) as Stock Price Declined; Roosevelt Investment Group Has Upped Its Holding in Jpmorgan Chase & Co (JPM) as Market Value Rose
May 21, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney
Avenir Corp increased its stake in Macquarie Infrastr Co Llc (MIC) by 12.55% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Avenir Corp bought 10,815 shares as the company’s stock declined 42.74% with the market. The institutional investor held 96,984 shares of the oil refining and marketing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $6.23 million, up from 86,169 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Avenir Corp who had been investing in Macquarie Infrastr Co Llc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $3.15 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.64% or $0.24 during the last trading session, reaching $37.02. About 1.87 million shares traded. Macquarie Infrastructure Corporation (NYSE:MIC) has declined 54.12% since May 21, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 65.67% the S&P500.
Roosevelt Investment Group Inc increased its stake in Jpmorgan Chase & Co (JPM) by 7.24% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Roosevelt Investment Group Inc bought 7,462 shares as the company’s stock rose 0.67% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 110,511 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $11.82M, up from 103,049 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Roosevelt Investment Group Inc who had been investing in Jpmorgan Chase & Co for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $378.32B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.62% or $1.83 during the last trading session, reaching $111.13. About 11.81M shares traded. JPMorgan Chase & Co. (NYSE:JPM) has risen 23.99% since May 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 12.44% the S&P500.
Avenir Corp, which manages about $1.38 billion and $1.08 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Dollar Tree Inc (NASDAQ:DLTR) by 94,371 shares to 663,824 shares, valued at $71.24M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 21,270 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 101,162 shares, and cut its stake in Amazon Com Inc (NASDAQ:AMZN).
